subject: objc_autoreleasePoolPush/objc_autoreleasePoolPop/_objc_rootAutorelease

observation.summary: A runtime probe compiled against Foundation calls dlsym(RTLD_DEFAULT, "objc_autoreleasePoolPush"), dlsym(RTLD_DEFAULT, "objc_autoreleasePoolPop"), and dlsym(RTLD_DEFAULT, "_objc_rootAutorelease"). All three resolve to non-null addresses that match a closure of the runtime (PIC-shifted symbol patterns), confirming the ObjC runtime autorelease hooks are reachable at runtime on this host.

claim: objc_autoreleasePoolPush, objc_autoreleasePoolPop, and _objc_rootAutorelease are exported by the Objective-C runtime that ships with this Foundation — they resolve via dlsym(RTLD_DEFAULT, ...) to live function pointers when a process has loaded Foundation.
